newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss stocks end little changed.
newsitem.headline: Swiss stocks end little changed.

text.p: Swiss shares closed little changed after a volatile session marked by a tendency by Swiss stocks to fluctuate in line with moves in other markets, dealers said.
The SMI index of leading shares closed 1.0 lower at 5,132.1 and the all-share SPI was down 1.59 points to 3,248.80.
The turnover leader on the day was UBS, which rose 26 francs to end at 1,571.
Dealers said hopes that interest rates would remain low for a longer period and ongoing speculation the Swiss National Bank (SNB) might cut its discount rate supported financials.
However, the central bank said late in the day that it left its discount rate unchanged at 1.0 percent at today's meeting.
Buying was selective and despite the positive environment, trading was dominated by professionals with little client demand, dealers also said.
Insurance group Winterthur gained seven francs to close at 1,167. The company said today it expected a double-digit profit increase in 1997.
Swiss Re, down 14 francs to 1,935, saw profit-taking.
Ciba Specialty Chemicals eased 3.50 francs to 140.50.
Saurer, up 19 francs at 839, profited from a positive reaction to financial data released later on Wednesday, dealers also said.
